transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I feel like I’ve let my family down taking on this mortgage. And at work, even little mistakes make me feel useless—like I deserve whatever bad happens to me.
Along with these feelings, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless most days?
Yeah, most days. There’s this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I go through the motions at work—carrying plates and smiling—but I don’t really feel anything good from it.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been going on for about a year and a couple months now. The feeling down and guilty part has been there most of that time.
Before this started about a year ago, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time that felt like this before.
How has your sleep been during this past year?
I’m not sure—I haven’t really noticed any clear change in my sleep over the past year.
Have you noticed a lack of energy or feeling constantly exhausted during this time?
I haven’t really noticed feeling constantly exhausted, no. My energy seems about the same as usual.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over this past year?
Yeah, it’s been pretty up and down. Some weeks I barely eat the staff meal at work, and then other nights I get home and just eat whatever’s in the kitchen to feel settled.
Have you been having any trouble concentrating, focusing, or making everyday decisions?

Yeah, a little. At work I’ve been having trouble keeping the numbers straight on the POS and the inventory sheets. Sometimes I just stare at the screen—I know I’ve done it for years—but I don’t trust what I just entered.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or feeling like you would be better off dead?
I don’t have a plan to hurt myself. But sometimes, lying awake before an early shift, I think it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up—like I wouldn’t have to keep failing at everything.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?

Yeah, I think so. I used to joke around with the regulars and text my brother after work, but lately I mostly just keep a straight face and say what I need to. Messages just sit there—I don’t really feel like answering.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually energized, euphoric, or wired, needing much less sleep than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a time where I felt especially energized or like I could get by on hardly any sleep.
